RootQuery.hbForm(id: Int, lang: String): HBForm
RootQuery.hbForms: [HBFormListItem]
RootMutation.hbSubmitForm(input: HbSubmitFormInput!): HbSubmitFormPayload

type HBConditionalLogic {
  action: String
  enabled: Boolean
  logicType: String
  rules: [HBConditionalLogicRule]
}

type HBConditionalLogicRule {
  fieldName: String
  operator: String
  value: String
}

type HBForm {
  createdAt: String
  fields: [HBFormField]
  id: Int!
  settings: HBFormSettings
  steps: [HBFormStep]
  title: String
  updatedAt: String
}

type HBFormField {
  conditionalLogic: HBConditionalLogic
  errorMessage: String
  format: String
  id: String
  label: String
  max: String
  min: String
  name: String
  options: [HBFormOption]
  pattern: String
  placeholder: String
  required: Boolean
  type: String
}

type HBFormListItem {
  createdAt: String
  id: Int!
  submissions: Int
  title: String
}

type HBFormOption {
  label: String
  value: String
}

type HBFormSettings {
  afterSubmit: String
  displayPageInfo: Boolean
  errorMessage: String
  redirectUrl: String
  submitText: String
  successMessage: String
}

type HBFormStep {
  fields: [HBFormField]
}

input HbFormFieldInput {
  name: String!
  value: String
}

input HbSubmitFormInput {
  clientMutationId: String
  fields: [HbFormFieldInput]!
  formId: Int!
  lang: String
  pageReferrer: String
  pageTitle: String
  pageUrl: String
}

type HbSubmitFormPayload {
  clientMutationId: String
  debug: [String]
  errors: [String]
  message: String
  submissionId: Int
  success: Boolean!
}
